scope.purpose: Structured comparison of positions, financial relationships, potential constituencies, strengths, weaknesses, documented controversies, and subjective nomination estimates.
limitations: Not a comprehensive opposition-research dossier, donor ledger, or full legislative voting inventory.
No unsubstantiated hidden scandal is alleged.
Historical donors, business investors, paid clients, organizations, and prospective political supporters are distinguished.
Sources were retrieved during the conversation; URLs and publication metadata are included for audit. No full FEC audit was performed.
Source reliability varies; official records are distinguished from reporting and analyst inference.
A report or committee finding is not automatically a criminal adjudication.

forecast_methodology.target: Conditional probability of winning the 2028 Republican nomination given that one of the five included candidates wins; not a full-field probability.
forecast_methodology.precision_note: Two decimal places preserve proportional normalization; they do not indicate measured precision or confidence intervals.
forecast_methodology.normalization: The five owner-authorized candidates sum to 100. These are conditional shares among the approved roster; unlisted contenders remain an explicit field-coverage uncertainty. No threshold permits automatic additions.
forecast_methodology.base_case: Uneven de-escalation efforts, lingering economic costs, congressional oversight beginning with the new Congress in January 2027, and conflict over responsibility.
forecast_methodology.probability_source: Subjective original weights proportionally normalized across the five included candidates; not polling, market odds, or a formal simulation.

candidate_inclusion_rule.assessment_note: Supersedes the imported >10% automatic inclusion rule. Outside contenders may be flagged for owner review, never added or assigned tracked probabilities by scheduled reviews.
